basics.name: Alex Example
basics.label: Junior Full-stack Developer
basics.summary: Career changer from logistics who builds full-stack web apps with Python, TypeScript and React. Shipped two projects used by real people, with tests and deployment. Looking for a junior full-stack role (EU remote).

projects.name: StudyCards
projects.description: Flashcard app with spaced repetition for language learners
highlights: Built a spaced-repetition scheduler that picks review intervals from answer streaks (1–60 days).
Designed a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend with JWT auth and 40+ pytest tests in CI.
Used by 25 classmates during one semester; fixed 12 issues they reported.

projects.name: ShiftBoard
projects.description: Shift planning tool for a local warehouse team
roles: Solo developer, for my former employer
highlights: Replaced a shared spreadsheet with a Next.js app for 18 workers, with roles and shift swaps.
Cut weekly planning time from about 3 hours to 30 minutes (measured by the team lead).
